faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions from business owners and our partners.

items.q: How much does it cost to build a mobile app?
items.a: The price mainly depends on the size of the project. We build the mobile app itself starting from 25 million UZS. We give an exact estimate after reviewing the project.
The timeline depends on the size of the project. On average, an MVP is ready in 4–6 weeks.

items.q: Do you work with existing mobile applications?
items.a: Yes. We can improve, modernize, maintain, optimize, and continue developing existing applications.

items.q: Do you work with IT companies?
items.a: Yes. We work with IT companies through white-label development, technical partnerships, and dedicated mobile teams.

items.q: Can you work with our existing development team?
items.a: Yes. TuronCore can integrate with your existing team and provide additional mobile development expertise.
Yes, we provide guaranteed technical support and ongoing post-launch maintenance packages for all our projects.

items.q: How do we start a project?
items.a: Just write to us via our contact form or Telegram. We will get back to you within 24 hours to schedule a meeting to discuss your goals.
